Bavarian text:
Bozn hot vor olm vo seinr günstign Log auf dr Hondelsstreck Augsburg-Venedig profitiert, desholb ischs a schun friah zu an Messestod gwordn.

translation: Bozn always profited from his favorable location on the Augsburg-Venice trade route, which is why it already became a trade dead end early on.
